source.reference: RetailOpt initial-inventory convention and legacy C-INIT
source.excerpt: Inventory is tracked by remaining life at the start of each period; r=shelf_life is the freshest bucket. Older buckets must not be initialized with invented stock.

text: At period 1, inventory in every older bucket with remaining life r < shelf_life[p] must be zero for every product and location. Do not initialize aged stock from a guessed demand or capacity number. The freshest bucket is handled separately by the fresh-inflow equation and is not covered by this asset.

validation.note: This is a declared RetailOpt modeling convention, not a universally valid inventory rule or independent semantic truth.
